author: Michael Jordan

quote: It's good sportsmanship to not pick up lost golf balls while they are still rolling.
author: Mark Twain

quote: Golf is a good walk spoiled.
author: Mark Twain

quote: When the going gets weird, the weird turn pro.
author: Hunter S. Thompson

quote: Many men go fishing all of their lives without knowing that it is not fish they are after.
author: Henry David Thoreau

quote: It's just a job. Grass grows, birds fly, waves pound the sand. I beat people up.
author: Muhammad Ali

quote: Just play. Have fun. Enjoy the game.
author: Michael Jordan

quote: Don't look back. Something might be gaining on you.
author: Satchel Paige

quote: As athletes, we're used to reacting quickly. Here, it's 'come, stop, come, stop.' There's a lot of downtime. That's the toughest part of the day.
author: Michael Jordan

quote: If winning isn't everything, why do they keep score?
author: Vince Lombardi

quote: Gold medals aren't really made of gold. They're made of sweat, determination, and a hard-to-find alloy called guts.
author: Dan Gable

quote: People ask me what I do in winter when there's no baseball. I'll tell you what I do. I stare out the window and wait for spring.
author: Rogers Hornsby

quote: Half the lies they tell about me aren't true.
author: Yogi Berra

quote: I want to rip out his heart and feed it to Lennox Lewis. I want to kill people. I want to rip their stomachs out and eat their children.
author: Mike Tyson

quote: You can't put a limit on anything. The more you dream, the farther you get.
author: Michael Phelps

quote: Show me a good loser, and I'll show you a loser.
author: Vince Lombardi

quote: A good hockey player plays where the puck is. A great hockey player plays where the puck is going to be.
author: Wayne Gretzky

quote: Serious sport has nothing to do with fair play. It is bound up with hatred, jealousy, boastfulness, disregard of all rules and sadistic pleasure in witnessing violence. In other words, it is war minus the shooting.
author: George Orwell

quote: I'd just as soon play tennis with the net down.
author: Robert Frost

quote: Baseball has the great advantage over cricket of being sooner ended.
author: George Bernard Shaw

quote: Winning is habit. Unfortunately, so is losing.
author: Vince Lombardi

quote: Hockey is a sport for white men. Basketball is a sport for black men. Golf is a sport for white men dressed like black pimps.
author: Tiger Woods

quote: I went to a fight the other night, and a hockey game broke out.
author: Rodney Dangerfield

quote: Adversity causes some men to break others to break records.
author: William Arthur Ward

quote: Most people never run far enough on their first wind to find out they've got a second.
author: William James

quote: I guess there is nothing that will get your mind off everything like golf. I have never been depressed enough to take up the game, but they say you get so sore at yourself you forget to hate your enemies.
author: Will Rogers

quote: I am building a fire, and everyday I train, I add more fuel. At just the right moment, I light the match.
author: Mia Hamm

quote: If a man watches three football games in a row, he should be declared legally dead.
author: Erma Bombeck

quote: You wouldn't have won if we'd beaten you.
author: Yogi Berra

quote: My motto was always to keep swinging. Whether I was in a slump or feeling badly or having trouble off the field, the only thing to do was keep swinging.
author: Hank Aaron

quote: The game of golf would lose a great deal if croquet mallets and billiard cues were allowed on the putting green.
author: Ernest Hemingway

quote: Thus so wretched is man that he would weary even without any cause for weariness... and so frivolous is he that, though full of a thousand reasons for weariness, the least thing, such as playing billiards or hitting a ball, is sufficient enough to amuse him.
author: Blaise Pascal

quote: I'm tired of hearing about money, money, money, money, money. I just want to play the game, drink Pepsi, wear Reebok.
author: Shaquille O'Neal

quote: I see great things in baseball. It's our game - the American game.
author: Walt Whitman

quote: Baseball is the only field of endeavor where a man can succeed three times out of ten and be considered a good performer.
author: Ted Williams

quote: Academe, n.: An ancient school where morality and philosophy were taught. Academy, n.: A modern school where football is taught.
author: Ambrose Bierce

quote: Baseball players are smarter than football players. How often do you see a baseball team penalized for too many men on the field?
author: Jim Bouton

quote: I regard golf as an expensive way of playing marbles.
author: Gilbert K. Chesterton

quote: All hockey players are bilingual. They know English and profanity.
author: Gordie Howe

quote: Football is an incredible game. Sometimes it's so incredible, it's unbelievable.
author: Tom Landry

quote: You can't win unless you learn how to lose.
author: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar

quote: These are my new shoes. They're good shoes. They won't make you rich like me, they won't make you rebound like me, they definitely won't make you handsome like me. They'll only make you have shoes like me. That's it.
author: Charles Barkley

quote: Sports do not build character. They reveal it.
author: Heywood Broun

quote: You win some, lose some, and wreck some.
author: Dale Earnhardt

quote: You don't play against opponents, you play against the game of basketball.
author: Bobby Knight

quote: Champions keep playing until they get it right.
author: Billie Jean King

quote: Basketball is like war in that offensive weapons are developed first, and it always takes a while for the defense to catch up.
author: Red Auerbach

quote: Baseball happens to be a game of cumulative tension but football, basketball and hockey are played with hand grenades and machine guns.
author: John Leonard

quote: Do you know what my favorite part of the game is? The opportunity to play.
author: Mike Singletary

quote: A lifetime of training for just ten seconds.
author: Jesse Owens

quote: Baseball is a game where a curve is an optical illusion, a screwball can be a pitch or a person, stealing is legal and you can spit anywhere you like except in the umpire's eye or on the ball.
author: James Patrick Murray

quote: Approach the game with no preset agendas and you'll probably come away surprised at your overall efforts.
author: Phil Jackson

quote: If you think it's hard to meet new people, try picking up the wrong golf ball.
author: Jack Lemmon

quote: Fishing is much more than fish. It is the great occasion when we may return to the fine simplicity of our forefathers.
author: Herbert Hoover

quote: If you drink don't drive. Don't even putt.
author: Dean Martin

quote: Give me golf clubs, fresh air and a beautiful partner, and you can keep the clubs and the fresh air.
author: Jack Benny

quote: Skiing combines outdoor fun with knocking down trees with your face.
author: Dave Barry

quote: If you watch a game, it's fun. If you play it, it's recreation. If you work at it, it's golf.
author: Bob Hope

quote: Golf is a game in which you yell 'fore,' shoot six, and write down five.
author: Paul Harvey

quote: Bobby Knight told me this: 'There is nothing that a good defense cannot beat a better offense.' In other words a good offense wins.
author: Dan Quayle

quote: I always turn to the sports pages first, which records people's accomplishments. The front page has nothing but man's failures.
author: Earl Warren

quote: Success is where preparation and opportunity meet.
author: Bobby Unser

quote: Golf is a day spent in a round of strenuous idleness.
author: William Wordsworth

quote: I know I am getting better at golf because I am hitting fewer spectators.
author: Gerald R. Ford

quote: I won't predict anything historic. But nothing is impossible.
author: Michael Phelps

quote: You know it's going to hell when the best rapper out there is white and the best golfer is black.
author: Charles Barkley

quote: Golf is a game in which one endeavors to control a ball with implements ill adapted for the purpose.
author: Woodrow Wilson

quote: One man practicing sportsmanship is far better than a hundred teaching it.
author: Knute Rockne

quote: Fans don't boo nobodies.
author: Reggie Jackson

quote: It's a round ball and a round bat, and you got to hit it square.
author: Pete Rose

quote: If you meet the Buddha in the lane, feed him the ball.
author: Phil Jackson

quote: The difference between the old ballplayer and the new ballplayer is the jersey. The old ballplayer cared about the name on the front. The new ballplayer cares about the name on the back.
author: Steve Garvey

quote: Golf is played by twenty million mature American men whose wives think they are out having fun.
author: Jim Bishop

quote: The trouble with jogging is that the ice falls out of your glass.
author: Martin Mull

quote: Wrestling is ballet with violence.
author: Jesse Ventura

quote: Life is about timing.
author: Carl Lewis

quote: You always get a special kick on opening day, no matter how many you go through. You look forward to it like a birthday party when you're a kid. You think something wonderful is going to happen.
author: Joe DiMaggio

quote: I don't want to play golf. When I hit a ball, I want someone else to go chase it.
author: Rogers Hornsby

quote: Tennis is a perfect combination of violent action taking place in an atmosphere of total tranquillity.
author: Billie Jean King

quote: Some people are born on third base and go through life thinking they hit a triple.
author: Barry Switzer

quote: Nobody's a natural. You work hard to get good and then work to get better. It's hard to stay on top.
author: Paul Coffey

quote: The triple is the most exciting play in baseball. Home runs win a lot of games, but I never understood why fans are so obsessed with them.
author: Hank Aaron

quote: The only way to prove that you're a good sport is to lose.
author: Ernie Banks

quote: Most ball games are lost, not won.
author: Casey Stengel

quote: Boxing has become America's tragic theater.
author: Joyce Carol Oates

quote: Golf appeals to the idiot in us and the child. Just how childlike golf players become is proven by their frequent inability to count past five.
author: John Updike

quote: The only thing a golfer needs is more daylight.
author: Ben Hogan

quote: Baseball is almost the only orderly thing in a very unorderly world. If you get three strikes, even the best lawyer in the world can't get you off.
author: Bill Veeck

quote: The two most important things in life are good friends and a strong bullpen.
author: Bob Lemon

quote: I don't know why people question the academic training of an athlete. Fifty percent of the doctors in this country graduated in the bottom half of their classes.
author: Al McGuire

quote: All sports for all people.
author: Pierre de Coubertin

quote: Sometimes in football you have to score goals.
author: Thierry Henry

quote: Play is the only way the highest intelligence of humankind can unfold.
author: Joseph Chilton Pearce

quote: Reverse every natural instinct and do the opposite of what you are inclined to do, and you will probably come very close to having a perfect golf swing.
author: Ben Hogan

quote: Sports are a microcosm of society.
author: Billie Jean King

quote: If I weren't earning $3 million a year to dunk a basketball, most people on the street would run in the other direction if they saw me coming.
author: Charles Barkley

quote: Gray skies are just clouds passing over.
author: Frank Gifford

quote: If a tie is like kissing your sister, losing is like kissing you grandmother with her teeth out.
author: George Brett

quote: Trying to sneak a fastball past Hank Aaron is like trying to sneak the sunrise past a rooster.
author: Joe Adcock

quote: Hitting is timing. Pitching is upsetting timing.
author: Warren Spahn

quote: I had pro offers from the Detroit Lions and Green Bay Packers, who were pretty hard up for linemen in those days. If I had gone into professional football the name Jerry Ford might have been a household word today.
author: Gerald R. Ford

quote: Have you ever noticed what golf spells backwards?
author: Al Boliska

quote: If you got the game, you got the game. That's why Tiger Woods is out there playing golf with Greg Norman.
author: Shaquille O'Neal

quote: I'm a competitive person and I love the challenge of mastering new things.
author: Sasha Cohen

quote: There isn't a flaw in his golf or his makeup. He will win more majors than Arnold Palmer and me combined. Somebody is going to dust my records. It might as well be Tiger, because he's such a great kid.
author: Jack Nicklaus

quote: He has the finest, fundamentally sound golf swing I've ever seen.
author: Jack Nicklaus

quote: He's going to be around a long, long time, if his body holds up. That's always a concern with a lot of players because of how much they play. A lot of guys can't handle it. But it looks like he can.
author: Jack Nicklaus

quote: You spend a good piece of your life gripping a baseball and in the end it turns out that it was the other way around all the time.
author: Jim Bouton

quote: Baseball life is a tough life on the family.
author: Nolan Ryan

quote: If a lot of people gripped a knife and fork the way they do a golf club, they'd starve to death.
author: Sam Snead

quote: The fewer rules a coach has, the fewer rules there are for players to break.
author: John Madden

quote: I play in the low 80s. If it's any hotter than that, I won't play.
author: Joe E. Lewis

quote: Relax? How can anybody relax and play golf? You have to grip the club, don't you?
author: Ben Hogan

quote: Any time Detroit scores more than 100 points and holds the other team below 100 points they almost always win.
author: Doug Collins

quote: The difference in golf and government is that in golf you can't improve your lie.
author: George Deukmejian

quote: You can make a lot of money in this game. Just ask my ex-wives. Both of them are so rich that neither of their husbands work.
author: Lee Trevino

quote: Baseball is drama with an endless run and an ever-changing cast.
author: Joe Garagiola

quote: What other people may find in poetry or art museums, I find in the flight of a good drive.
author: Arnold Palmer

quote: The integrity of the game is everything.
author: Peter Ueberroth

quote: It is almost impossible to remember how tragic a place the world is when one is playing golf.
author: Robert Wilson Lynd

quote: Bulls do not win bull fights. People do.
author: Norman Ralph Augustine

quote: My family knew, but most of the sporting world did not realize that my right hand been some 75% paralyzed.
author: Bill Toomey

quote: There was endless action - not just football, but sailboats, tennis and other things: movement. There was endless talk - the ambassador at the head of the table laying out the prevailing wisdom, but everyone else weighing in with their opinions and taking part.
author: Charles Spalding

quote: Eighteen holes of match play will teach you more about your foe than 18 years of dealing with him across a desk.
author: Grantland Rice

quote: Nobody roots for Goliath.
author: Wilt Chamberlain

quote: I'll let the racket do the talking.
author: John McEnroe

quote: When I was 40, my doctor advised me that a man in his 40s shouldn't play tennis. I heeded his advice carefully and could hardly wait until I reached 50 to start again.
author: Hugo Black

quote: You know they're not going to lose 162 consecutive games.
author: Harry Caray

quote: One thing you learned as a Cubs fan: when you bought you ticket, you could bank on seeing the bottom of the ninth.
author: Joe Garagiola

quote: Pro football is like nuclear warfare. There are no winners, only survivors.
author: Frank Gifford

quote: I started playing ball when I was a kid. My dad was a pro ball player and he passed on his knowledge to me.
author: Kurt Russell

quote: Every great batter works on the theory that the pitcher is more afraid of him than he is of the pitcher.
author: Ty Cobb

quote: What's a good tournament for him? Winning it. He's good enough.
author: Greg Norman

quote: Don't play too much golf. Two rounds a day are plenty.
author: Harry Vardon

quote: Overall the fundamentals seem to be there and he's obviously got a very mature head on his shoulders. He's got a kind of presence.
author: Nick Price

quote: New Yorkers love it when you spill your guts out there. Spill your guts at Wimbledon and they make you stop and clean it up.
author: Jimmy Connors

quote: Perhaps the single most important element in mastering the techniques and tactics of racing is experience. But once you have the fundamentals, acquiring the experience is a matter of time.
author: Greg LeMond

quote: You don't suffer, kill yourself and take the risks I take just for money. I love bike racing.
author: Greg LeMond

quote: I went through baseball as 'a player to be named later.'
author: Joe Garagiola

quote: I'm not buddy-buddy with the players. If they need a buddy, let them buy a dog.
author: Whitey Herzog

quote: Olympism is the marriage of sport and culture.
author: Juan Antonio Samaranch

quote: Many baseball fans look upon an umpire as a sort of necessary evil to the luxury of baseball, like the odor that follows an automobile.
author: Christy Mathewson

quote: Baseball is a public trust. Players turn over, owners turn over and certain commissioners turn over. But baseball goes on.
author: Peter Ueberroth

quote: Other sports play once a week but this sport is with us every day.
author: Peter Ueberroth

quote: Football is violence and cold weather and sex and college rye.
author: Roger Kahn

quote: I was showing early symptoms of becoming a professional baseball man. I was lying to the press.
author: Roger Kahn

quote: Tennis and golf are best played, not watched.
author: Roger Kahn

quote: He hits it long. His shoulders are impressively quick through the ball. That's where he's getting his power from. He's young and has great elasticity.
author: Nick Faldo

quote: He hits the ball a long way and he knows how to win.
author: Gary McCord

quote: He's got an overall flair for the game. It looks to me like he really loves what he does and he can't wait to get up in the morning, go hit some balls and go play.
author: Gary McCord

quote: The bell that tolls for all in boxing belongs to a cash register.
author: Bob Verdi

quote: What's unfortunate about buying a pitcher for $12 million is that he carries no warranty.
author: Bob Verdi

quote: He's got everything. He' not a great player yet because he hasn't won any major championships, but it's a matter of time. He's an outstanding talent. I didn't realize how tall he is.

quote: There are two theories on hitting the knuckleball. Unfortunately, neither of them works.
author: Charley Lau

quote: If you are going to throw a club, it is important to throw it ahead of you, down the fairway, so you don't have to waste energy going back to pick it up.
author: Tommy Bolt

quote: If your man is a sports enthusiast, you may have to resign yourself to his spouting off in a monotone on a prize fight, football game or pennant race.
author: Marilyn Monroe

quote: I like sports, and I enjoy playing basketball and lifting weights.
author: Joel Osteen

quote: I hate all sports as rabidly as a person who likes sports hates common sense.
author: H. L. Mencken

quote: I've told Billy if I ever caught him cheating, I wouldn't kill him because I love his children and they need a dad. But I would beat him up. I know where all of his sports injuries are.
author: Angelina Jolie

quote: I liked the energy of cooking, the action, the camaraderie. I often compare the kitchen to sports and compare the chef to a coach. There are a lot of similarities to it.
author: Todd English

quote: Don't force your kids into sports. I never was. To this day, my dad has never asked me to go play golf. I ask him. It's the child's desire to play that matters, not the parent's desire to have the child play. Fun. Keep it fun.
author: Tiger Woods

quote: The American people are sheep. They're comfortable, rich, working. It's like the Romans, they're happy with bread and their spectator sports. The Super Bowl means more to them than any right.
author: Jack Kevorkian

quote: The problem with winter sports is that - follow me closely here - they generally take place in winter.
author: Dave Barry

quote: I used to play sports. Then I realized you can buy trophies. Now I am good at everything.
author: Demetri Martin

quote: Honestly, I don't listen to nobody else's music but my own. It's kind of like sports to me. You don't see Kobe Bryant at a LeBron James game - he just works on his own game. And that's what I do. I only listen to me, so I can criticize and analyze and all those things.
author: Lil Wayne

quote: For truly it is to be noted, that children's plays are not sports, and should be deemed as their most serious actions.
author: Michel de Montaigne

quote: Even from their infancy we frame them to the sports of love: their instruction, behavior, attire, grace, learning and all their words azimuth only at love, respects only affection. Their nurses and their keepers imprint no other thing in them.
author: Michel de Montaigne

quote: I'm a visual thinker, really bad at algebra. There's others that are a pattern thinker. These are the music and math minds. They think in patterns instead of pictures. author: Temple Grandin

quote: I think that from the time you start playing sports as a child you see that your responsibility to your team is to play the best that you can play as an individual... and yet, not take anything away from being part of a team.
author: Wayne Gretzky

quote: Sports teaches you character, it teaches you to play by the rules, it teaches you to know what it feels like to win and lose-it teaches you about life.
author: Billie Jean King

quote: The best kids are going to become the best. But the best thing about it is that you're going to learn lessons in playing those sports about winning and losing and teamwork and teammates and arguments and everything else that are going to affect you positively for the rest of your life.
author: Carl Lewis

quote: I look at athletes in all sports and try to picture what kind of football player they'd be, what position they'd play and so on.
author: Lou Holtz

quote: I don't know anything that builds the will to win better than competitive sports.
author: Richard M. Nixon

quote: Black people dominate sports in the United States. 20% of the population and 90% of the final four.
author: Chris Rock

quote: Even if I did have, you know, a 'Sports Illustrated' body, I'd still wear elegant clothes.
author: Adele

quote: The addiction to sports, therefore, in a peculiar degree marks an arrested development in man's moral nature.
author: Thorstein Veblen

quote: I have never seen a wrestling match or a prize fight, and I don't want to. When I find out a man is interested in these sports, I drop him.
author: Hedy Lamarr

quote: If you're a sports fan you realize that when you meet somebody, like a girlfriend, they kind of have to root for your team. They don't have a choice.
author: Jimmy Fallon

quote: Well, I'm not a big sports fan.
author: Jeff Bridges

quote: One afternoon when I was 9, my dad told me I'd be skipping school the next day. Then we drove 12 hours from Melbourne to Sydney for the Centenary Test, a once-in-a-lifetime commemorative cricket match. It was great fun - especially for a kid who was a massive sports fan.
author: Hugh Jackman

quote: But sports carried me away from being in a gang, or being associated with drugs. Sports was my way out.
author: LeBron James

quote: I enjoy sports in person.
author: Shania Twain

quote: I'm sort of like a lame, single guy in a red sports car.
author: Billy Corgan

quote: I couldn't find the sports car of my dreams, so I built it myself.
author: Ferdinand Porsche

quote: The main thing is healthy eating, exercise, which I do for special events, like if it's Sports Illustrated, or the swim suit catalogue for Victoria's Secret, or my own calendar that I did for the year 2000.
author: Heidi Klum

quote: I'm a mad lover of sport. You cannot say a bad word to me about sports. So I know business is involved and I know it can be cynical, and, of course, I watch it, but for me it's pure.
author: Hugh Jackman

quote: When you look at golf films before us they're all - garbage or satire. A lot of sports films tend to vilify the opposition. Where the opposition becomes this big angry monster, so big you can't beat him.
author: Shia LaBeouf

quote: I live by 'Go big or go home.' That's with everything. It's like either commit and go for it or don't do it at all. I apply that to everything. I apply that to relationships, I apply that to like sports, I apply that to everything. That's what I live by. That's how I like it.
author: Paul Walker

quote: When did I know I had talent? I think it started when I first started playing sports, organized sports.
author: LeBron James

quote: I was always a sports nut but I've lost interest now in whether one bunch of mercenaries in north London is going to beat another bunch of mercenaries from west London.
author: John Cleese

quote: I think exercise tests us in so many ways, our skills, our hearts, our ability to bounce back after setbacks. This is the inner beauty of sports and competition, and it can serve us all well as adult athletes.
author: Peggy Fleming

quote: Sports and entertainment are the only places where inner-city kids see themselves being able to succeed. Their intellectual development is something they don't relate to.
author: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar

quote: The plays and sports of children are as salutary to them as labor and work are to grown persons.
author: Samuel Richardson

quote: I went to a football school, which meant that I went to a university that served up education and was simultaneously operating a sports franchise.
author: Susan Orlean

quote: I have long been one of those tedious people who rails against the coronation of 'student-athletes.' I have heard the argument that big-time athletics bring in loads of money to universities. author: Susan Orlean

quote: It's become another dimension to who I am. I don't think Sports Illustrated is going to be wanting me. But who cares? I'm at a different place in my life.
author: Cindy Crawford

quote: I love sports. I love animals. I love kids. I want to save the world. So how do I combine all those things? I don't know.
author: Joan Jett

quote: Sports is human life in microcosm.
author: Howard Cosell

quote: Breaking records is not something you expect to be doing. That's like a sports thing, it's not usually a comedy and writing thing.
author: Louis C. K.

quote: Women's sports is still in its infancy. The beginning of women's sports in the United States started in 1972, with the passage of Title 9 for girls to finally get athletic scholarships.
author: Billie Jean King

quote: I'm girlie in the sense that I like makeup, but I also love sports and man food.
author: Carrie Underwood

quote: In the sports arena I would say there is nothing like training and preparation. You have to train your mind as much as your body.
author: Venus Williams

quote: We're not doing outrageous fashion I make sports clothes that are relatively conservative, clothes that everyone wears.
author: Calvin Klein

quote: Don't let anyone turn you into a slave. You're a slave if you let the media tell you that sports and entertainment are more important than developing your brain.
author: Benjamin Carson

quote: The things that people do now in sports, you can't even believe. These are complete total athletes. To see what human beings can do in the highest level is amazing.
author: Billie Joe Armstrong

quote: You cannot mix sports with politics.
author: Jackie Chan

quote: I love sports. Whenever I can, I always watch the Detroit Tigers on the radio.
author: Gerald R. Ford

quote: Sports have become increasingly more specialized, but that doesn't mean they shouldn't be fun.
author: Mia Hamm

quote: I think extreme sports are really good for relieving stress.

quote: I've always been a guy who wants to play sports, not watch them.
author: Shaun White

quote: I always tell people that our sports aren't that dangerous.
author: Shaun White

quote: What drives me now is the fact that I feel like I still have so many tricks that I want to learn and so many things that I can still do. And so many cool things outside of sports that I have been doing.
author: Shaun White

quote: There's a whole lot more to the African-American community than entertainment and sports.
author: J. C. Watts

quote: That's the biggest gap in sports, the difference between the winner and the loser of the Super Bowl.

author: Rooney Mara

author: Lucy Powell

quote: Sports is the toy department of human life.
author: Howard Cosell

quote: The importance that our society attaches to sport is incredible. After all, is football a game or a religion? The people of this country have allowed sports to get completely out of hand.
author: Howard Cosell

quote: Sports is like a war without the killing.

quote: Don't sell yourself short because without that you can't go far in life because after sports the only thing you know is sports and you can't do anything else with that.
author: Bo Jackson

quote: Americans' addiction to sports, with the NFL at the top, is based on the excitement generated by the potential for the unexpected great play which can only happen with honest competition from great athletes.
author: Arlen Specter

quote: I'm not good at anything except writing jokes. I wasn't good at sports, I wasn't good at anything artsy, ever. I think there was a real worry for a while about what I would be good at. I was just this chubby little Indian kid who looked like a nerd.
author: Mindy Kaling

quote: I think sometimes when it comes to sports, and especially relationships between players and coaches, that people lose track, lose a sense of reality.

quote: That's what we need nowadays, is more children that have goals other than being a sports figure or some kind of celebrity. I think it's great that a kid wants to learn more and wants to be at the peak of learning, especially at that young.

quote: When they take surveys of women in business, of the Fortune 500, the successful women, 80% of them, say they were in sports as a young woman.
author: Billie Jean King

quote: Sports without music is just a game. Music makes it entertaining.
author: Ice Cube

quote: I sort of always had an inkling towards some kind of an art form. I grew up in a very small town, and I just figure-skated. My dad played hockey and I was surrounded by sports, but it wasn't quite doing it for me. I wasn't totally fulfilled, and I did a lot of skating.
author: Rachel McAdams

quote: A significant piece of the wealth that the NFL owners garner is a result of the enormous TV revenues they get - and those revenues are supported by a legislatively granted exemption from the antitrust laws that has been made applicable to sports leagues, primarily the NFL.
author: Eliot Spitzer

quote: I would love to be associated with some sports organization. I was a journalism major. That's kind of intriguing, to do something in the political-commentary arena.
author: J. C. Watts

quote: My sister is totally my dad's daughter because she loves sports.
author: Ashley Tisdale

quote: Unfortunately the world is what it is now. People don't get along for whatever reason. As professional athletes, in a way we're almost ambassadors for peace, because sports brings everyone together.
author: Venus Williams

author: Channing Tatum

quote: I'm not a big sports fan.
author: Harlan Coben

quote: I don't necessarily love the sports per se, I love the stories behind them. Also in a kind of perverse way I like to study what it does to us, why we care so much. It's caring about something that's utterly meaningless.
author: Harlan Coben

author: Harvey Weinstein

quote: I went to Ohio University studying arts and history, and playing football. But I was only interested in girls, my pals and sports. I only did the minimum for school.

author: Dennis Miller

author: Andrew Shue

quote: I'm a big sports fan. Football. Cricket.
author: Danny Boyle

quote: I never really participated in specific sports or anything, but once I hit 40, I started to get a little bit more active and began swimming more.
author: Shigeru Miyamoto

author: Haruki Murakami

author: Josh Hutcherson

quote: I enjoy sports. I get a real joy from playing sports but I don't look for those movies. Oliver Stone wanted to know if I would do Any Given Sunday and it just didn't appeal to me.
author: Kevin Costner

quote: Now, I know you expected me to say that, well, I just kick back in the rocking chair, fished a little bit, listened to Willie Nelson tapes and watched old baseball games on the Classic Sports network. And, tell you the truth, I have done that for maybe about five total minutes.
author: Dan Rather

quote: I wanted to use sports for social change.
author: Billie Jean King

quote: In the seventies we had to make it acceptable for people to accept girls and women as athletes. We had to make it okay for them to be active. Those were much scarier times for females in sports.
author: Billie Jean King

quote: There's not a long track record of people leaving professional sports to become a software developer.
author: Curt Schilling

quote: I used to play a lot of racket sports, tennis and squash.

quote: Sports without music, it's nothing but a game. Music adds the emotion.
author: Ice Cube

quote: Music has done a lot to enhance the emotions of sports. It's played in arenas. Whenever there is footage cut together they're always using music. And it goes together, you know.
author: Ice Cube

quote: As the National Football League and other pro sports increasingly reckon with the early dementia, mental health issues, suicides and even criminal behavior of former players, the risk of what's known as chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE), is becoming clear.
author: Jeffrey Kluger

quote: The families of many athletes - incensed at the sports leagues and hoping to make games safer overall - are increasingly making the brains of players who die prematurely and suspiciously available for study. Some athletes are even making the bequest themselves.
author: Jeffrey Kluger

quote: I think I was a good student, because I jumped over a school. My main interest was basically history and literature. Sports were basically basketball and swimming at a pool. I was so happy.

quote: I've always had an interest in sports across the board.
author: Gabrielle Union

quote: I played sports year around: basketball, soccer, softball and I ran track year around, from the time I was, like, six, seven.
author: Gabrielle Union

quote: I'm nothing more than a sports slave.

quote: There is so much hypocrisy in sports.
author: Dennis Rodman

quote: My chief gifts are - naturally good at all sports with a raw talent for pretty much everything, which if nurtured could develop into improper talent.
author: Michael Sheen

quote: A rabid sports fan is one that boos a TV set.
author: Jimmy Cannon

quote: The tradition in Serbia has always been team sports - football, basketball, handball, volleyball and water polo, individual sports are not supported.
author: Novak Djokovic

quote: I'm the kind of guy that if I don't work out, I will get bigger and look like one of the guys who used to play sports.
author: Seann William Scott

quote: I was a total athlete. I loved sports, but when I realized I wasn't going to be a professional athlete, I realized I wanted to be in movies.
author: Seann William Scott

quote: I love extreme sports, I like snowboarding and motorcross and rollerblading and hockey.
author: Jeremy London

quote: I've aways been good at picking up certain things, like sports and dancing.
author: Channing Tatum

quote: There are kids who get on a BMX bike when they're eight years old and they go, 'Whoa, this is incredible,' and grow up to do extreme sports. It's the same for me with acting.
author: Joaquin Phoenix

quote: I never played sports. I wasn't any good at them.
author: Leighton Meester

quote: Being a celebrity you always get really good seats to sporting events but you never get as good seats as the photographers get. And I really love sports. So one of the scams I have going now is I want to learn sports photography so I can get better seats at a sporting event.
author: Drew Carey

quote: But sports photography isn't something you just pick up overnight. You can't do it once a year for fun and expect to do a good job. And I take pride in what I do.
author: Drew Carey

quote: I know I could be the host of 'SportsCenter' in two years if I changed my show today to sports.
author: Gary Vaynerchuk

quote: Making movies was more a reaction to not being chosen for sports. Other kids were out there playing at whatever I was off making something blow up and filming it, or making a mould of my sister's head using alginating plaster.
author: J. J. Abrams

quote: I've been a sports fan all my life, and like most other actors, I'm convinced I could have been a pro athlete if Hollywood hadn't come calling.
author: Jamie Foxx

quote: It sounds like a cliche, but it... you do sing about what you know about. And I grew up in a small town, and I grew up in a place where your whole world revolved around friends, family, school, and church, and sports.
author: Kenny Chesney

quote: I grew up being into sports and I wasn't trained to move my body in the right way for dancing. I'm the last one to get any moves correct. In rehearsals it's always, 'OK, one more take for Zac.'
author: Zac Efron

quote: Sports is a metaphor for overcoming obstacles and achieving against great odds. Athletes, in times of difficulty, can be important role models.
author: Bill Bradley

quote: There is a syndrome in sports called 'paralysis by analysis.'

quote: I play sports.
author: Josh Hutcherson

quote: I don't watch a lot of television. Sports and news, that's it.
author: Larry Hagman

quote: There's three things men always talk about - women, sports, and cars.

quote: Of course, in our grade school, in those days, there were no organized sports at all. We just went out and ran around the school yard for recess.

author: Joe Nichols

quote: I'm not into extreme sports or something. I just live a quiet life.
author: Charlie Kaufman

quote: There is no life for girls in team sports past Little League. I got into tennis when I realized this, and because I thought golf would be too slow for me, and I was too scared to swim.
author: Billie Jean King

quote: I liked the game, I enjoyed the game, and the game fed me enough, and gave me enough rewards to reinforce that this is something that I should spend time doing, and that I could possibly make a priority in my life, versus other sports.
author: Julius Erving

quote: One of the things in the back of my mind is that, after my sports experience, I never want to be, totally consumed by any one endeavor, other than my family life.
author: Julius Erving

quote: Books had instant replay long before televised sports.
author: Bernard Williams

quote: I've had the good fortune to have a much more diverse life than most people would, professional sports and television and news and movies.
author: Ted Turner

quote: I have zero interest in sports of any kind - professional, college or international.
author: Jimmy Wales

quote: I have to wear two sports bras when I do my cardio. It takes a lot to hold these puppies up!
author: Fergie

quote: I'm really into extreme sports and just having fun.
author: Kellan Lutz

quote: I am so fidgety - I swear I have ADD - and I always need to be doing something or being outside, just playing sports.
author: Kellan Lutz

quote: Sport was my absolute love. It was very sporty household. We had my - my brother and I both loved sports.
author: Delta Goodrem

quote: I got amazing training both with Theatre Sports... back in Edmonton, Alberta - I can't give those people enough credit - and the daytime drama I did. Incredible training, both of them.
author: Nathan Fillion

quote: In any small town, sports are really important to the high school, and I wasn't very good at sports.
author: Martina McBride

quote: It certainly is dangerous that there are only a few clubs left in Europe that can afford to pay millions. At the end of the day however, the spectators decide the rates of pay - by watching the games and consuming the goods and services advertised on sports TV programmes.
author: Angela Merkel

quote: I was a sports fan, but I also went to peace marches.
author: Tim Robbins

quote: I think they need to get a more reliable way of watching television on the laptop. Because I travel so much, if I want to watch my favorite sports team it might not be showing in that place, so I want a reliable way to watch whatever I want to watch on my laptop.
author: John Legend

quote: I've been looking at companies that are on a positive path vs. a negative path and I've come to use the language of sports, winning streaks and losing streaks.
author: Rosabeth Moss Kanter

quote: Amateurism is the strongest form of discrimination in sports. Because it discriminates against the underprivileged, it discriminates against the poor. If we want sports to go back to the wealthy, let's make it amateur again.
author: Carl Lewis

quote: I always separated sports and my personal life.
author: Carl Lewis

quote: If you look at things that really affect people's lives - sport, the arts, charities - they were always at the back of the queue for government money - health, social security, defence, pensions were all way ahead. And each of those areas - sports, the arts, the lottery - got relatively petty cash from the government.
author: John Major

quote: Your body's really only meant to compete at the highest levels of combat sports for a few years.
author: Joe Rogan

quote: I never in my wildest imagination dreamed that I would somehow become a sports commentator.
author: Joe Rogan

quote: I don't want to have to say, Honey, you know, could you turn off the sports channel because I'm not a big sports fan, and I don't love the television being on just for the sake of turning on. I'd like turning on for some thing specific.
author: Lynn Redgrave

quote: A supermodel needed to be able to be on 'Sports Illustrated,' to be able to walk runways, to be able to do beauty ads, to be on covers. And the girls now can no longer be on covers and be in the ads because your actresses have taken over all the jobs. I don't know what happened, but we want our jobs back.
author: Kim Alexis

quote: Growing up in the time of Title IX - it was passed when I was 10 - I got a front-row seat to so many great moments in women's sports. Of course I didn't know it at the time.
author: Jackie Joyner-Kersee

quote: When I was in elementary school, we weren't allowed to do sports other than cheerleading. By junior high, they let us play, but we had to come back after 6:30 p.m. to practice because there was only one gymnasium and the boys used it first.
author: Jackie Joyner-Kersee

quote: Competing in both track and field and basketball for the Bruins I have a lot of great memories to choose from. But my all-time favorite moment in collegiate sports has to be in 1982 when we won UCLA's first NCAA title in track.
author: Jackie Joyner-Kersee

quote: We live in a world where sports have the potential to bridge the gap between racism, sexism and discrimination. The 2012 Olympic Games was a great start but hopefully what these games taught us is that if women are given an opportunity on an equal playing field the possibilities for women are endless.
author: Jackie Joyner-Kersee

quote: I had my boy in Boston on Easter Sunday. That kills me, from a sports perspective. He's a Boston baby and I'm a New York guy.
author: Kevin James

quote: I only have two things in my life, my family and work. If there's any time left over, then I play sports.
author: Mark Zandi

quote: Soccer and cricket were my main sports growing up. I had trials as a soccer player with a few clubs interested, Crystal Palace being one, but it was cricket which became my chosen profession.
author: Ian Botham

quote: Where I came from, sports were the only way to get out front.
author: Joe Namath

quote: I was focused on athletics, outdoors, sports.
author: Joe Namath

quote: I was lucky enough when it came to sports and work ethic to be taught some basics that continue to be important.
author: Joe Namath

quote: We're going to have more kids playing, and we're going to have a better chance of finding those players Minor sports in a community is for fun and recreation. For everyone.
author: Bobby Orr

quote: Everyone thought I was going to die like a year later, they didn't know. So I helped educate sports, and then the world, that a man living with HIV can play basketball. He's not going to give it to anybody by playing basketball.
author: Magic Johnson

quote: I love various sports, including basketball, tennis and billiards.
author: Yani Tseng

quote: Boxing, mixed martial arts and tennis are the hardest sports to train for.
author: Andy Murray

quote: A lot of athletes use sports psychologists.
author: Andy Murray

quote: I like to follow my favorite team and talk sports with my band or fans. You won't believe how many musicians are sports fans. We have so much time on tour that we need these outlets for relaxation.
author: Garth Brooks

quote: I do not like sports, unless you consider treating all humankind with love and respect a sport.
author: Todd Barry

quote: I don't think there's anything that is a greater area of discrimination against women today than the fact that nowhere in the world is there a female role model in team sports that more than half of a general audience would recognize.
author: Warren Farrell

quote: Men's competitive team sports focus on the balance between individual achievement and team achievement with the emphasis on team achievement.
author: Warren Farrell

quote: We've just got to be careful - with all sports, let alone cricket - I think there's so much emphasis on doing the right thing all the time, but I think the public want to be entertained when they come to watch sport.
author: Shane Warne

quote: Most Indians go into education. Their parents just push them into education like parents in Australia push them into sports.
author: Mahesh Bhupathi

quote: I didn't go to normal children school. I went to sports school when I was 8. So I studied martial arts.
author: Jet Li

quote: I had no interest in sports so I didn't make friends in that traditional way where kids are in public school and they go and they join clubs, and play sports. So I kind of had to find my own way to make friends and get attention and so I just was the class clown.
author: Zach Braff

quote: As a kid who wasn't into sports, at school I felt almost alienated at times, whereas in the theatre community there was this amazing sense of camaraderie. Early on, we would go to rehearsals with my dad and I was like the mascot for the backstage crew. That was a big part of my childhood, so I dreamed of one day doing a play in London.
author: Zach Braff

quote: I also have a soft spot for spicy chicken wings. They are always best eaten at dives and sports bars, like Wogie's in the West Village, New York City, near my house.
author: Gail Simmons

quote: In most sports, your brain and your body will cooperate... But in rock climbing, it is the other way around. Your brain doesn't see the point in climbing upwards. Your brain will tell you to keep as low as possible, to cling to the wall and not get any higher. You have to have your brain persuading your body to do the right movements.
author: Jo Nesbo

quote: People have called me Superman my whole life. In various sports, that seems to be the common theme. My favorite superhero is actually the Incredible Hulk. He's the only superhero that can't die.
author: Robert Griffin III

quote: I keep getting these extraordinary letteres, really weird ones from American sports stars - I've always thought you were one pretty lady and now that you're single I want to meet you for a drink.
author: Elizabeth Hurley

quote: I don't want someone to watch sports in bed. That drives me nuts.
author: Elizabeth Hurley

author: Matt Walsh

quote: Talk radio has almost ruined the sports fan.
author: Phil Simms

quote: I have a pretty expanded view of what art is. I include pop music and even some sports.
author: Elizabeth Price

quote: Anyone could be in the orchestra, or sports team, or arts club at my school. It was precisely the kind of inclusivity that now meets with a sort of scorn and derision as a prizes-for-all culture that generates only mediocrity. There's something so insulting about the idea that including lots of people means mediocrity.
author: Elizabeth Price

quote: I grew up playing sports. There is a clear line between success and failure.
author: Tiki Barber

quote: I pick projects according to how fascinating they are to me, and it has resulted in a broad reach. My records are actually in five different sports: balloons, airplanes, airships, gliders, and sailboats.
author: Steve Fossett

quote: Sport must be amateur or it is not sport. Sports played professionally are entertainment.
author: Avery Brundage

quote: The Olympic Games must not be an end in itself, they must be a means of creating a vast programme of physical education and sports competitions for all young people.
author: Avery Brundage

quote: I have three kids, and I'm a coach for a lot of their sports, so I'm around them a lot, but I see friends of mine with older kids and they don't really interact so much, other than giving them a place to live.
author: Mike O'Malley

quote: It's too bad that one has to conceive of sports as being the only arena where risks are, for all of life is risk exercise. That's the only way to live more freely, and more interestingly.
author: William Sloane Coffin, Jr.

quote: The more violent the body contact of the sports you watch, the lower the class.
author: Paul Fussell

quote: We wanted Nike to be the world's best sports and fitness company. Once you say that, you have a focus. You don't end up making wing tips or sponsoring the next Rolling Stones world tour.
author: Philip Knight

quote: I really think more fledgling novelists - and many current and even established novelists - should get out into the real world and cover local politics, sports, culture, and crime and write it up on deadline.
author: C. J. Box

quote: There are almost no sports within which mortal accidents are not a reality.
author: Dietrich Mateschitz

quote: When launching a product called an Energy Drink and named Red Bull, a product that stimulates body and mind, it is a short step to the roots where Red Bull came from. We have been doing this for 20 years - now it's called adventure sports, extreme sports, and outdoor sports.
author: Dietrich Mateschitz

quote: I'm thrilled, I'm grateful, I'm blessed. I played for the world's greatest professional sports team in history. Once a Dallas Cowboy, always a Dallas Cowboy.
author: Bob Hayes

quote: I think track is still one of the most exciting participant sports, but we haven't been able to capitalize on that excitement through television and the print media.
author: Bob Beamon

quote: I regard sports first and foremost as entertainment, so dry documentary narration is not for me.
author: Jack Brickhouse

quote: I always seem to get parts where I play the sports professional - and that's not me at all!
author: Jay Ryan

quote: Since my induction into the Sports Hall of Fame, I have wanted to have my No. 3 Chevy on exhibit for sports fans to see. I hope others will enjoy the car as much as I have.
author: Junior Johnson

quote: I love sports - if I'm not acting, I'm probably doing sports.
author: Gabriel Basso

quote: I was never into sports, and my passion was the arts as long as I could remember.
author: Stephen Wallem

quote: I don't pay much attention to sports.
author: Jack Abramoff

quote: I used to play football for Real Madrid, and to be on stage for two hours, I can tell you it takes the same amount of strength.
author: Julio Iglesias

quote: Tennis takes care of everything. It requires agility and quickness to get to the ball, core strength to get power into your shorts and stamina to last for an entire match. In addition to toning your arms and shoulders, it's a total body workout for your legs and abs, and works your heart and core unlike any other sport.
author: Samantha Stosur

quote: My dad's a bodybuilder. My whole life I've been taught to train the hard way. I believe in earning strength, not buying it. My grandfather raised me old school: In baseball, you work for whatever you get.
author: Gary Sheffield

quote: Whatever I lack in size and strength and speed, I kind of make up for in being grittier. When it comes to something like basketball I'm definitely not the best guy on the court, but I love elbowing and pushing people out or boxing them out.
author: Steven Yeun

quote: I love sharing my knowledge of hitting with others. Now coaches and players at all levels can learn my systematic approach to hitting a baseball with more consistency, mental strength and accuracy.
author: Dusty Baker

quote: I have always been an outstanding football player, I have always had uncanny abilities, great arm strength, an immense ability to play the game from a quarterback standpoint. The problem was that I wasn't given the liberty to do certain things when I was young.
author: Michael Vick

quote: I'm probably the least flexible athlete you'll find. When it comes to yoga, I can't get in the positions and I can't hold them. You have to be pretty flexible to do it. Once you get certain positions, you have to have the core strength to hold those positions. It's a pretty good workout.
author: Steve Blake

quote: The supreme quality for leadership is unquestionably integrity. Without it, no real success is possible, no matter whether it is on a section gang, a football field, in an army, or in an office.
author: Dwight D. Eisenhower

quote: Every day is a new opportunity. You can build on yesterday's success or put its failures behind and start over again. That's the way life is, with a new game every day, and that's the way baseball is.
author: Bob Feller

quote: Positive thinking is the key to success in business, education, pro football, anything that you can mention. I go out there thinking that I'm going to complete every pass.
author: Ron Jaworski

quote: So much of a professional athlete's success depends upon not necessarily the play itself but how he deals with... always saying how you deal with good, is just as important as how you deal with bad.
author: Brett Favre

quote: Anytime you play a team sport, the success of the team really makes everything better. It's nice.
author: Ricky Williams

quote: A lot of football success is in the mind. You must believe you are the best and then make sure that you are.
author: Bill Shankly

quote: I'm not a defender of old or new football managers. I believe in good ones and bad ones, those that achieve success and those that don't.
author: Jose Mourinho

quote: There is no correlation between a childhood success and a professional athlete.
author: Carl Lewis

quote: Four years of football are calculated to breed in the average man more of the ingredients of success in life than almost any academic course he takes.
author: Knute Rockne

quote: To win in Australia, for me, has to be the ultimate success because the Aussies live for sport.
author: Ian Botham

quote: I just want to continue the success and be an athlete that is shown in a good light in New York City.
author: Victor Cruz

quote: It's not just the NFL. Every other league has a draft. It has been fundamental to the success of professional sports.
author: Roger Goodell

quote: You know, a football coach is nothing more than a teacher. You teach them the same subject, and you have a group of new guys every year.
author: Darrell Royal

quote: My dad was a football player - a soccer player - for Manchester United, and I loved playing football, but I also happened to be the guy in class who was pretty good at sight reading. My teacher gave me scripts, and I was very comfortable.
author: Ian McShane

quote: And I found out, the other part of it is that I found out and in my desire to life successfully, that baseball fit very well into my life. It's been a great teacher, trainer, mentor and you'll see what I mean in the next few minutes that I have to speak.
author: Dave Winfield

quote: I lived in a town of 400 until I was like nine or ten. My dad coached all the sports - he was a gym teacher and health teacher for grades K-12.
author: January Jones

quote: If I had a personal wish for the new ideas in this new book it would be that every parent, every counselor, every teacher, every professor, every sports coach that deals with young people would understand the three circle concept.
author: James Collins

quote: Quite honestly I never had a desire to be an actor. I tell people, I did not choose acting acting chose me. I never grew up wanting to be an actor. I wanted to play football. In about 9th grade an English teacher told me I had a talent to act. He said I should audition for a performing arts high school so I did on a whim. I got accepted.
author: Ving Rhames

quote: I never really did sports growing up. Maybe that's why they intrigue me. The technology that goes into that clothing is steps ahead, so it's always been something I look towards.
author: Alexander Wang

quote: Being nerdy just means being passionate about something, including everyone - the coolest people on Earth are passionate and therefore nerdy about something whatever it is, whether it's sports, or gaming, or technology, or fashion, or beauty, or food, or whatever.
author: Zachary Levi

quote: I'm really looking forward to the Hall of Fame ceremonies. It's going to be unbelievable - just crazy. I'm looking forward to thanking all the fans for inspiring me to go out there and play my best football each and every game.
author: Jerry Rice

quote: I had the pleasure, as Robin said, to live a childhood dream as many young Americans and Puerto Rican children live that play youth baseball. And I feel honored and very thankful for that opportunity.
author: Nolan Ryan

quote: The game of basketball has been everything to me. My place of refuge, place I've always gone where I needed comfort and peace. It's been the site of intense pain and the most intense feelings of joy and satisfaction. It's a relationship that has evolved over time, given me the greatest respect and love for the game.
author: Michael Jordan

quote: When I lose the sense of motivation and the sense to prove something as a basketball player, it's time for me to move away from the game.
author: Michael Jordan

quote: For a competitive junkie like me, golf is a great solution because it smacks you in the face every time you think you have accomplished something. That to me has taken over a lot of the energy and competitiveness for basketball.
author: Michael Jordan

quote: I think about baseball when I wake up in the morning. I think about it all day and I dream about it at night. The only time I don't think about it is when I'm playing it.
author: Carl Yastrzemski

quote: I'm not comfortable being preachy, but more people need to start spending as much time in the library as they do on the basketball court.
author: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar

quote: A good athlete always mentally replays a competition over and over, even in victory, to see what might be done to improve the performance the next time.
author: Frank Shorter

quote: In college I never realized the opportunities available to a pro athlete. I've been given the chance to meet all kinds of people, to travel and expand my financial capabilities, to get ideas and learn about life, to create a world apart from basketball.
author: Michael Jordan

quote: I stepped away to find out more about myself, which I was having difficulty doing as a football player. I got a chance to travel the world. I studied Eastern philosophy, and I've grown as a person so much.
author: Ricky Williams

quote: I love to take risks, I love to travel, and I'm very outdoor-sy, so any girl who can pick up a football and throw a spiral will definitely catch my attention.
author: Kellan Lutz

quote: I think they need to get a more reliable way of watching television on the laptop. Because I travel so much, if I want to watch my favorite sports team it might not be showing in that place, so I want a reliable way to watch whatever I want to watch on my laptop.
author: John Legend

quote: I like people who are enthused about things they do, like travel, sports, work. I like being with people who have things they're excited about.
author: Parker Stevenson

quote: Absolutely the worst thing about this job is the travel and being away from family. I have a wife and three wonderful children, the kids are all active in sports and it's very difficult to up and leave and miss them growing up.
author: Roy Clark

quote: As a former football player who has carried a football more than 4,000 times, trust me, I did not go into ballroom dancing with my body being 100 percent, with no aches or pains or ailments coming with me. When you're dancing, you're doing stuff that your body's not used to, and so you start to aggravate those old injuries.
author: Emmitt Smith

quote: That's the hard part about sport: as men we haven't started to be in our prime, but as athletes we are old people. I needed support. I lost trust and did stupid things.
author: Boris Becker

quote: And when I retired, trust me, not only did Nolan Ryan, but the entire Ryan family had withdrawals from baseball. And it was tough.
author: Nolan Ryan

quote: The first few weeks football players look at you like you are speaking a foreign language. My job is to get them to trust me, trust the system. I ask them to run in a way that makes no sense to them.
author: Ato Boldon

quote: Baseball is a public trust. Players turn over, owners turn over and certain commissioners turn over. But baseball goes on.
author: Peter Ueberroth

quote: Truth is tough. It will not break, like a bubble, at a touch nay, you may kick it about all day like a football, and it will be round and full at evening.
author: Oliver Wendell Holmes

quote: The truth is the Super Bowl long ago became more than just a football game. It's part of our culture like turkey at Thanksgiving and lights at Christmas, and like those holidays beyond their meaning, a factor in our economy.
author: Bob Schieffer

quote: Truth is tough. It will not break, like a bubble, at the touch, nay, you may kick it about all day like a football, and it will be round and full at evening.
author: Oliver Wendell Holmes, Jr.

quote: Serious sport has nothing to do with fair play. It is bound up with hatred, jealousy, boastfulness, disregard of all rules and sadistic pleasure in witnessing violence. In other words, it is war minus the shooting.
author: George Orwell

quote: Serious sport is war minus the shooting.
author: George Orwell

quote: Business is a combination of war and sport.
author: Andre Maurois

quote: Basketball is like war in that offensive weapons are developed first, and it always takes a while for the defense to catch up.
author: Red Auerbach

quote: Sectional football games have the glory and the despair of war, and when a Texas team takes the field against a foreign state, it is an army with banners.
author: John Steinbeck

quote: Cards are war, in disguise of a sport.
author: Charles Lamb

quote: Sports is like a war without the killing.
author: Ted Turner

quote: Where does it stop? You get offered money for your wedding, then for your kids, new houses, holidays... We earn enough from football and sponsorships, why do you need any more?
author: Ryan Giggs

quote: There was endless action - not just football, but sailboats, tennis and other things: movement. There was endless talk - the ambassador at the head of the table laying out the prevailing wisdom, but everyone else weighing in with their opinions and taking part.
author: Charles Spalding

quote: Conventional wisdom notwithstanding, there is no reason either in football or in poetry why the two should not meet in a man's life if he has the weight and cares about the words.
author: Archibald MacLeish

quote: Men kick friendship around like a football, but it doesn't seem to crack. Women treat it like glass and it goes to pieces.
author: Anne Morrow Lindbergh

quote: The reason women don't play football is because 11 of them would never wear the same outfit in public.
author: Phyllis Diller

quote: Being a woman is of special interest only to aspiring male transsexuals. To actual women, it is simply a good excuse not to play football.
author: Fran Lebowitz

quote: And I highly recommend for all the women in the world, even if they're 71, you can never take for granted that he loves you. It's always good to flirt with him. It's a great sport.
author: Salma Hayek

quote: Now that women are jockeys, baseball umpires, atomic scientists, and business executives, maybe someday they can master parallel parking.
author: Bill Vaughan

quote: Women's sports is still in its infancy. The beginning of women's sports in the United States started in 1972, with the passage of Title 9 for girls to finally get athletic scholarships.
author: Billie Jean King

quote: As a kid, I was always mad - just noticing the women at Thanksgiving, running around the kitchen, while the men were watching football. For one, I don't want to cook, and for two, I hate football. I was stuck in the middle.
author: Beth Ditto

quote: When they take surveys of women in business, of the Fortune 500, the successful women, 80% of them, say they were in sports as a young woman.
author: Billie Jean King

quote: America believes in education: the average professor earns more money in a year than a professional athlete earns in a whole week.
author: Evan Esar

quote: As I understand it, sport is hard work for which you do not get paid.
author: Irvin S. Cobb

quote: Football is like life - it requires perseverance, self-denial, hard work, sacrifice, dedication and respect for authority.
author: Vince Lombardi

quote: People who work together will win, whether it be against complex football defenses, or the problems of modern society.
author: Vince Lombardi

quote: In order to excel, you must be completely dedicated to your chosen sport. You must also be prepared to work hard and be willing to accept constructive criticism. Without one-hundred percent dedication, you won't be able to do this.
author: Willie Mays

quote: Football taught me how hard you had to work to achieve something.
author: Kenny Chesney

quote: I think the best place to work in football is England.
author: Jose Mourinho

quote: I obviously take a lot of pride in what I do on the football field, because that has the ability to influence a lot of people. That puts smiles on people's faces. That gives people a pep in their step on Monday morning when they go back to work.
author: Drew Brees

quote: I don't feel right unless I have a sport to play or at least a way to work up a sweat.
author: Hank Aaron

quote: I learned that the only way you are going to get anywhere in life is to work hard at it. Whether you're a musician, a writer, an athlete or a businessman, there is no getting around it. If you do, you'll win - if you don't, you won't.
author: Bruce Jenner

quote: The truth is the Super Bowl long ago became more than just a football game. It's part of our culture like turkey at Thanksgiving and lights at Christmas, and like those holidays beyond their meaning, a factor in our economy.
author: Bob Schieffer

quote: It's quite a famous story that takes place on Christmas Eve, and the Germans, French, and Scottish are trying to make peace one night and they bury their dead and they play football. I play a German opera singer, in German, which I never have so I am really excited about that.
author: Diane Kruger

quote: My parents were kind of over protective people. Me and my sister had to play in the backyard all the time. They bought us bikes for Christmas but wouldn't let us ride in the street, we had to ride in the backyard. Another Christmas, my dad got me a basketball hoop and put it in the middle of the lawn! You can't dribble on grass.
author: Jimmy Fallon

quote: I love Halloween, trick or treating and decorating the house. And I love Thanksgiving, because of the football and the fall weather. And of course, I love Christmas - that's my favorite of all!
author: Joe Nichols

quote: It is never too late to get into tennis! While I started playing at the age of 8 when my parents gave me a tennis racquet for Christmas, tennis is a lifelong sport that can be enjoyed by people of almost any age. It's also something you never forget once you learn.
author: Samantha Stosur

quote: Music is my thing. It's my thing it's what I love. It's what I do. It's football to me it's Christmas to me religion to me poetry to me.
author: Ryan Adams

quote: I had my boy in Boston on Easter Sunday. That kills me, from a sports perspective. He's a Boston baby and I'm a New York guy.
author: Kevin James
